assumptions.kinetic_model: Competing first-order natural decay (k0 = 1/tau0) versus pseudo-first-order reductive quenching (kq = kQ*[Red]); monoexponential excited-state decay. The problem note k_F >> k_ISC makes S1 -> T1 intersystem crossing negligible, so S1 and T1 quench as independent populations with their printed lifetimes. The quenching fraction kq/(k0+kq) is *derived* in Lean from this model via the improper integral of the quenching channel rate, not assumed.
assumptions.reporting: Three significant figures as per TASK.json uniform blind evaluation default; quantum 0.1 percentage points; nearest multiple, ties half away from zero (project Reporting contract).

verification_commands.result: exit code 0; #print axioms for quenchingPercentage_S1, quenchingPercentage_T1, fractionQuenched_of_competingChannels, validSubmission_S1, validSubmission_T1 all report only [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]; one cosmetic unusedVariables linter warning on the explicit model hypothesis hpop; no sorry/admit/unsafe/custom axioms.
